name: mateu-figma-to-yaml
description: Reads a Figma file (REST JSON, GET /v1/files/:key) designed with the Mateu library and writes specs/ui YAML, mapping every Mateu/* instance back through ../contract.json.

scripts.golden: node bin/figma-to-yaml.mjs test/fixtures/starwars.figma.json --out test/golden --clean && node bin/figma-to-yaml.mjs test/fixtures/native.figma.json --out test/golden-native --clean
